definitions.basis: AI-drafted comparisons of the debate batch's definition records; every cell cites words of the record's quote or of further lines of the same pinned PDF; every cell and statement passed two blind AI checks, tested on planted errors; no person has reviewed them

excluded: legacy research pages and network assets
record explorer page (replaced by the record graph)

gap_closing.basis: each counted item passed two blind AI checks tested on planted errors; no person has reviewed it

overview.basis: counts from data.json and the public view; a few measures fixed at 2026-10-18 are named in overview.py; 'What could come next' is a proposal; the AI safety coverage map is an AI-drafted outline marked against the atlas's sources, not reviewed by a person

publication_provenance.scope: Explorer export of the merged canonical commit; canonical pins are retained. Separate Lean extracts and Metamath sidecar excluded.
publication_provenance.source_generator: AGR_Atlas_Infrastructure/ontology_v2/explorer_v1/build.py run in a clean worktree of canonical_source_commit

record_graph.basis: groups from Louvain community detection over the recorded links, with a weaker tie for records that quote the same source; positions are navigation, not evidence

snapshot.scope: joined view at the canonical commit; 1750 records; public presentation snapshot

visual_atlas.basis: selects and joins fields of the debate batch, its AI review states and the gap-closing pilot; adds no claim; no person has reviewed it
